latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — server-side injection vulnerability assessment skill.

- Provides procedures for testing OS command injection, path traversal, file inclusion (LFI/RFI), XXE, SOAP injection, HTTP Parameter Injection/Pollution, and SMTP injection in web applications.
- Includes detection and filter bypass techniques, assessment tasks, CWE mappings, and countermeasure guidance.
- Supports both white-box (code review) and black-box (live application) security testing contexts.
- Focuses exclusively on non-SQL back-end injection risks, with clear audience and scope.
- Maps to relevant vulnerabilities as described in "The Web Application Hacker's Handbook," 2nd Edition.
